title: Identification of oleoylethanolamide as an endogenous ligand for HIF-3alpha.
authors: Diao, Xiaotong; Ye, Fei; Zhang, Meina; Ren, Xintong; Tian, Xiaoxu; Lu, Jingping; Sun, Xiangnan; Hou, Zeng; Chen, Xiaoyu; Li, Fengwei; Zhuang, Jingjing; Ding, Hong; Peng, Chao; Rastinejad, Fraydoon; Luo, Cheng; Wu, Dalei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构、HDX-MS和MD模拟揭示内源脂质OEA结合HIF-3α PAS-B口袋并增强异二聚体稳定性的分子机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（转录因子HIF-3α）且采用物理模拟方法，但未聚焦TF-DNA结合位点预测或DNA互作界面，故评7分。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factors (HIFs) are alpha/beta heterodimeric transcription factors modulating cellular responses to the low oxygen condition. Among three HIF-alpha isoforms, HIF-3alpha is the least studied to date. Here we show that oleoylethanolamide (OEA), a physiological lipid known to regulate food intake and metabolism, binds selectively to HIF-3alpha. Through crystallographic analysis of HIF-3 alpha/beta heterodimer in both apo and OEA-bound forms, hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS), molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and biochemical and cell-based assays, we unveil the molecular mechanism of OEA entry and binding to the PAS-B pocket of HIF-3alpha, and show that it leads to enhanced heterodimer stability and functional modulation of HIF-3. The identification of HIF-3alpha as a selective lipid sensor is consistent with recent human genetic findings linking HIF-3alpha with obesity, and demonstrates that endogenous metabolites can directly interact with HIF-alpha proteins to modulate their activities, potentially as a regulatory mechanism supplementary to the well-known oxygen-dependent HIF-alpha hydroxylation.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子（HIFs）是α/β异二聚体转录因子，调节细胞对低氧条件的响应。在三种HIF-α亚型中，HIF-3α至今研究最少。在此，我们展示了油酰乙醇胺（OEA），一种已知调节食物摄入和代谢的生理脂质，能选择性地结合HIF-3α。通过对HIF-3α/β异二聚体在无配体（apo）和OEA结合形式下的晶体学分析、氢-氘交换质谱（HDX-MS）、分子动力学（MD）模拟以及生化和细胞实验，我们揭示了OEA进入并结合HIF-3α的PAS-B口袋的分子机制，并表明这导致异二聚体稳定性增强及HIF-3功能调节。将HIF-3α识别为选择性脂质传感器，与近期人类遗传学发现将HIF-3α与肥胖相关联一致，并证明内源性代谢物可直接与HIF-α蛋白相互作用以调节其活性，可能作为已知的氧依赖性HIF-α羟基化调节机制的补充。
